scope: four Rust deltas only; source reviewed directly from immutable git objects without resetting or editing shared checkout

findings.evidence: Only macOS UnixStream overrides the new default-None trait method. Exact raw EINVAL plus independent same-descriptor zero-wait POLLHUP is required, while POLLERR, POLLNVAL, poll failure, wrong error and live peer refuse the fallback.
findings.consequence: A write completed before peer close can proceed through the no-op UnixStream flush and then the existing bound response read.

findings.evidence: DeadlineStream flush computes remaining(write_deadline) before the timeout setter and checks the same remaining deadline after either original flush or fallback. The Mac fallback also checks that same deadline before its no-op flush. No duration or accepted time is reset.

write_request still requires write_all to complete before flush. No new request write, socket mode change, managed retry or replay classification is added. Bound response header, request ID, payload digest, length and original post-exchange deadline checks remain unchanged; closed peer without a valid response still fails fatally.
The existing EINVAL/HUP/no-ERR/no-NVAL predicate moved to a shared helper; original read deadline check and MSG_DONTWAIT receive remain unchanged.

Two additional signed-policy tests require absent markers for explicit/unbound or malformed commands, preserve noncommand marker for real extractor absence, keep command lockdown and intrinsic blocks, and export three bounded real native receipt cases. No production receipt, approval or command-control code changed.
